title: Requirement-ID families
description: The registry of requirement-ID prefixes (conventions/families.yml). Every requirement ID's prefix is a registered family; reserved prefixes are held for rules that will migrate here with their IDs unchanged and may not be registered as new families.

schema_version.description: Version of this file's shape. Always 1.

families.description: Registered families. A requirement's family must match its convention's topic.

topic.description: The conventions/ subdirectory whose conventions hold this family's requirements.

owner.description: Who reviews changes to this family.

reserved.description: Prefixes claimed for rules that exist elsewhere today and will move here keeping their IDs.

source.description: Where the rules carrying this prefix live today.
